xna-type.name: Picture
xna-type.summary: Provides access to a picture in the media library.
xna-type.remarks: The Picture class provides information about a picture, including the picture's graphic ( GetTexture ), thumbnail ( GetThumbnail ), Name , Date , and Height and Width . You can obtain a Picture object through the PictureCollection.Item indexer.

property.name: Album
property.summary: Gets the picture album that contains the picture.

property.name: Date
property.value: Date and time associated with the picture's file, as a DateTime structure.

property.name: Height
property.value: Height of this picture, in pixels.

property.name: IsDisposed
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the object is disposed.
property.value: true if the object is disposed; false otherwise.

property.name: Name
property.summary: Gets the name of the Picture.

property.name: Width
property.value: Width of this picture, in pixels.

method.name: Dispose
method.summary: Immediately releases the unmanaged resources used by this object.

overload.summary: Immediately releases the unmanaged resources used by this object.

method.name: Equals
method.summary: Determines whether the specified Picture is equal to this Picture.

overload.summary: Determines whether the specified Picture is equal to this Picture.

parameters.parameter: Picture to compare with this instance.

overload.returns: true if the objects are equal; false otherwise.

overload.summary: Determines whether the specified Object is equal to this Picture.

parameters.parameter: Object to compare with this instance.

overload.returns: true if the objects are equal; false otherwise.

method.name: Finalize
method.summary: Releases unmanaged resources and performs other cleanup operations before the Picture is reclaimed by garbage collection.

overload.summary: Releases unmanaged resources and performs other cleanup operations before the Picture is reclaimed by garbage collection.
overload.remarks: This method overrides Finalize System.Object.Finalize . Application code should not call this method. The object's Finalize method is automatically invoked during garbage collection, unless a call to the GC.SuppressFinalize method has disabled finalization by the garbage collector. For more information, see Finalize Methods and Destructors , Cleaning Up Unmanaged Resources , and Overriding the Finalize Method .

method.name: GetHashCode
method.summary: Gets the hash code for this instance.

overload.summary: Gets the hash code for this instance.

method.name: GetImage
method.summary: Returns the stream that contains the image data.

overload.summary: Returns the stream that contains the image data.
overload.returns: Stream object that contains the image data.

method.name: GetTexture
method.summary: Gets the picture as a texture.

overload.summary: Gets the picture as a texture.

parameters.parameter: Game service provider, obtained from the Game.Services property.

overload.returns: Texture with the graphical content of the picture.
overload.remarks: GameServiceContainer Class implements IServiceProvider , so you can pass the value of the Game.Services property as the serviceProvider parameter.

method.name: GetThumbnail
method.summary: Returns the stream that contains the picture's thumbnail image data.

overload.summary: Returns the stream that contains the picture's thumbnail image data.
overload.returns: Stream object that contains the thumbnail image data.

method.name: ToString
method.summary: Returns a String representation of the Picture.

overload.summary: Returns a String representation of the Picture.

method.name: op_Equality
method.summary: Determines whether the specified Picture instances are equal.

overload.summary: Determines whether the specified Picture instances are equal.

parameters.parameter: Object to the left of the equality operator.
Object to the right of the equality operator.

overload.returns: true if the objects are equal; false otherwise.

method.name: op_Inequality
method.summary: Determines whether the specified Picture instances are not equal.

overload.summary: Determines whether the specified Picture instances are not equal.

parameters.parameter: Object to the left of the inequality operator.
Object to the right of the inequality operator.

overload.returns: true if the objects are not equal; false otherwise.
